cohort: Obstetricians (n=195), unaffected mothers of babies with EB (n=75), and mothers with EB who had given birth (n=44)
finding: Most patients with EB who are capable of giving birth do not have an increased risk for pregnancy-related complications, and normal vaginal delivery appears to be safe.
mod_finding: There were no significant differences in blistering at birth in babies delivered via normal vaginal delivery and Caesarean section.
